# Week Back Partners

> Fractional COO in Toronto. Jeong Park maps how your company's work really moves and rebuilds the slow parts with AI, so your best people get their time back.

I map how work really moves through your company and rebuild the slow parts with AI, so your people spend their week on the work only they can do.

Based in Toronto, Ontario. Contact: jeongpark95@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeongwpark

## Track record
- 10+ years: in operating seats, from first hire to acquisition
- 5 functions: built and led from day one, across engineering, product, sales, operations and people
- $0 → $1M+: in annual revenue within 12 months, the third revenue line I've built from zero
- 100+ person org: mapped end to end, so every team works from the same process and the slow parts get rebuilt

Worked at: OV Loop (fintech), Cultos (loyalty tech, acquired), Toronto Climate Week (100+ volunteers), Authenticiti (enterprise software).

## Where I usually come in
- We doubled, and every decision still goes through the founder. As COO of a funded startup, I set company-wide goals, hired a head of people operations, and grew the team from 10 to over 20 in six months.
- We've grown, but the way we work hasn't caught up. I map how work actually moves before changing anything, so everyone can see where it gets stuck and agree on what to change first.
- Good people spend their week on work a system should be doing. I find where the hours go, redesign the work, and automate what's left, keeping a person on the decisions that matter. Sometimes the right call is to leave something alone, like a 4,100-person database import we chose not to do.
- We bought AI tools, and nobody really uses them. I start from the work instead of the tool, build with the people who will use it, and train them until it's part of their week. If a tool isn't earning its place, I'll say so.

## How an engagement runs
1. I learn how your company really runs. For the first few weeks I follow real work from start to finish and map who talks to whom and where information gets stuck.
2. We pick what's worth changing. You get a short list of the bottlenecks that cost the most time, the ones AI can take on, and the ones I'd leave exactly as they are.
3. I build the tools with your team. Research and data entry move to AI tools your people use every day, so their week goes to the parts of the job that need a person.
4. Your team takes it over. Everything is documented and your people are trained to run it, so it keeps working whether I'm in the room or not.

Price: From CAD 10K a month. I work with a small number of companies at a time so I can be inside the work. We start with three months, then go month to month. If the first month doesn't produce something your team uses, you can stop.
